description: This file defines the Transaction class within the Opencart\'s Catalog Controller Mail namespace. It handles the process of sending email notifications related to customer transactions, including retrieving customer details, store info, language settings, composing the email content, and dispatching the email. The class extends the core Controller class and provides an index method that performs these actions, primarily to notify customers of transactions via email.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: A controller class for managing email notifications related to customer transactions within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to generate and send a transaction-related email to the customer with details such as store info, transaction total, and message content.
